text:
🚨 IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING THE NYC SHIH TZU MEETUP 🚨

If you haven’t heard by now, Mason is in the hospital fighting for his life. 💔

Under normal circumstances, Mason and I would be getting ready for one of our favorite days of the year. But right now, our only focus is getting Mason through this.

Unfortunately, both Mason and I will not be able to attend Sunday’s meetup.

After a lot of thought, I’ve decided to carry on with the meetup in Mason’s honor. ❤️

This meetup has always been about bringing our Shih Tzu community together, and I know Mason would want his fellow Ewoks to still have their day. 🐾

The costume contest is cancelled, but we will still have our group photo at 2:30 PM as planned.

I know this isn’t the announcement any of us expected, and it breaks my heart that I won’t be there with all of you. But I hope you’ll go, celebrate our incredible Shih Tzu community, take lots of pictures, and most importantly, send some love and positive thoughts to my boy.

Please tag me in all of your posts and stories so I can see everyone from the hospital. It will mean more to me than you know. ❤️

And if you see a little Shih Tzu in the crowd who looks like an Ewok… give him an extra hug for Mason. 🥺🐾

This one is for Mason. Our Head Ewok. Our OG. Our boy. ❤️

#shihtzu
